title: UniVer: A Unified Perspective for Multi-step and Multi-draft Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2605.04543v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Models via draft-then-verify, where verification can be framed as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem. Existing approaches typically handle multi-draft and multi-step aspects in isolation, applying either flat OT to single-step drafts or per-token rejection sampling to tree-structured candidates. This separation leaves the joint regime (where multi-step dependencies meet multi-draft branching) poorly optimized, as local verification rules fail to exploit the coupling between horizontal and vertical dimensions of candidate trees. In this paper, we propose a unified perspective that casts tree-based verification as a conditional OT problem. Our key insight is that vertical dependencies can be abstracted through prefix acceptance probabilities, which act as dynamic scaling factors to actively guide horizontal draft selection. translated_title: UniVer：多步与多草稿投机解码的统一视角
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过“先起草、后验证”的方式加速大语言模型，其中验证过程可以建模为最优传输（OT）问题。现有方法通常将多草稿与多步骤两个维度割裂开来处理：要么对单步草稿应用扁平最优传输，要么对树状结构候选进行逐token的拒绝采样。这种割裂导致联合场景（即多步依赖与多草稿分支同时存在）得不到充分优化，因为局部验证规则未能利用候选树水平维度与垂直维度之间的耦合关系。本文提出一种统一视角，将基于树的验证问题转化为条件最优传输问题。我们的关键洞察是：垂直方向的依赖关系可以通过前缀接受概率来抽象，这些概率作为动态缩放因子，能够主动引导水平方向的草稿选择。基于这一原理，我们提出了UniVer，一种验证算法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出UniVer，将树状投机解码的验证统一建模为条件最优传输问题，通过前缀接受概率作为动态缩放因子主动引导草稿选择，从而联合优化多步依赖与多草稿分支之间的耦合关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes UniVer, which casts tree-based verification in speculative decoding as a conditional optimal transport problem, using prefix acceptance probabilities as dynamic scaling factors to actively guide draft selection and jointly optimize the coupling between multi-step dependencies and multi-draft branching.
